project.title: Muhammad Ali Center
project.maker: Dogstudio for the Muhammad Ali Center

why: A strong reference for making a deep institutional archive feel explorable rather than overwhelming: a layered timeline starts with broad ideals, then reveals more detailed related content through deliberate zoom levels.

compositions.title: Timeline as a distinct immersive destination
compositions.study: Dogstudio describes the Muhammad Ali timeline as an immersive experience within the wider site, dedicated to browsing key moments from his life.
compositions.reuse: Treat a dense chronology as a named destination with its own orientation and pacing, rather than appending every event to a conventional content page.

compositions.title: Broad-to-specific content hierarchy
compositions.study: The case frames the wider platform around cultural offerings, education, social-justice initiatives, and community programmes before introducing the dedicated timeline.
compositions.reuse: Establish a clear primary information architecture before offering an immersive branch, so an expressive interaction does not become the only route into institutional content.

assets.notes: Dogstudio identifies Founders Grotesk X-Condensed, Antonia Variable, and Guillon as the project type combination; no type files or source artwork are included here.
assets.reuse: Use an independently licensed or original type system with clear display, narrative, and utility roles instead of reproducing the source typography.

assets.notes: The source describes multiple timeline zoom levels that lead from high-level ideas toward related content.
assets.reuse: Keep the active zoom level, available depth, and return path visible whenever an interface lets people enter a layered narrative.

motion.title: Progressive detail through zoom levels
motion.study: The first-party case describes an immersive timeline with several levels of zoom for moving from broad ideas to detailed related content.
motion.fallback: Reduced-motion behavior was not established by the source. Provide direct section navigation and a readable chronological list before adding animated zoom transitions.

interactions.title: Layered timeline exploration
interactions.study: The timeline supports exploring a life story at more than one granularity instead of requiring one long linear pass.
interactions.reuse: Offer a visible overview, bounded steps into detail, and an explicit return control when turning chronology into an exploratory interface.

implementation.format: Institutional website with an immersive, CMS-editable timeline module
implementation.notes: Dogstudio's case study attributes design and build to Dogstudio and states that the timeline, like almost the entire site, is CMS-editable. This entry records only reusable interaction and editorial principles; all client imagery, typefaces, branding, and source code remain external.
